@dataclass
class SiteSession:
    """A website of the run (`siteId`, `url`, `credentials`) worked in its own tab."""

    site: dict
    context: BrowserContext
    trace: Trace
    pages: list[Page] = field(default_factory=list)
    events: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # what the helpers did since the model last looked
    view: str = ""
    lock: asyncio.Lock = field(default_factory=asyncio.Lock)
    stamp: int = 0
    logins: int = 0
    seen: str = ""  # every view's text this session, to check notes against
    shown: tuple = ()  # (url, title, view) the model has now, so an unchanged page is not sent again
    base: tuple = ()  # the same for the latest view it got in full; changes are told against this one
    visits: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)  # page URL -> times the model arrived on it
    last_url: str = ""
    scripted: bool = False  # the popup closer is installed in this context

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self.site["siteId"]

    @property
    def page(self) -> Page:
        open_pages = [p for p in self.pages if not p.is_closed()]
        self.pages = open_pages
        return open_pages[-1]

    async def start(self, attempts: int = 2) -> str:
        """
        Open the site's start page in a new tab, signed in, within START_SECONDS, once more on failure: a hung
        sign-in (a cookie button that never answers, a page that never loads) must not hold a worker, or the
        whole bid, for minutes. A tab that lands on the browser's own error page counts as failed.
        """
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            try:
                view = await asyncio.wait_for(self._open(), START_SECONDS)
                if self.page.url.startswith("chrome-error:") or not self.view.strip():
                    raise ConnectionError(f"the start page did not load ({self.page.url[:80]})")
                return view
            except Exception as error:
                self.trace.event(self.name, "start_failed", attempt=attempt + 1,
                                 error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
                for page in self.pages:
                    try:
                        await page.close()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                self.pages = []
        raise TimeoutError(f"{self.name}: the site could not be opened in {attempts} attempts")

    async def _open(self) -> str:
        if not self.scripted:
            await self.context.add_init_script(AUTO_CLOSE_JS)
            self.scripted = True
        page = await self.context.new_page()
        self._watch(page)
        await self._goto(self.site["url"])
        return await self.look()

    def _watch(self, page: Page) -> None:
        self.pages.append(page)
        page.on("dialog", self._on_dialog)
        page.on("popup", self._on_popup)

    def _on_popup(self, popup: Page) -> None:
        self._watch(popup)
        self.events.append(f"a new window opened ({popup.url}); you are now in it, it closes back to the last one")

    async def _on_dialog(self, dialog: Dialog) -> None:
        self.events.append(f"browser {dialog.type} said: {dialog.message!r}; accepted")
        await dialog.accept()

    async def revive(self) -> None:
        """A session whose tabs are all gone (e.g. after a failed start) gets a fresh tab on the site's start page,
        so looking and acting never fail on an empty tab list."""
        if any(not page.is_closed() for page in self.pages):
            return
        page = await self.context.new_page()
        self._watch(page)
        self.events.append("the tab was gone; opened the website again")
        self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="revive")
        await self._goto(self.site["url"])

    async def _goto(self, url: str) -> None:
        try:
            await self.page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
        except Exception as error:  # a slow load event still leaves a usable page
            self.events.append(f"navigation was slow or failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:160]}")
        await self.settle()

    async def settle(self) -> None:
        """Let the page finish and run the generic helpers, but never longer than SETTLE_SECONDS: a click that never
        returns (seen on a cookie notice) must not block the tab for minutes."""
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(self._settle(), SETTLE_SECONDS)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            self.events.append("the page kept loading; continuing with what it shows")
            self.trace.event(self.name, "helper_error", helper="settle", error=f"timeout after {SETTLE_SECONDS} s")

    async def _settle(self) -> None:
        page = self.page
        self.logins = 0  # a timeout later in the run may need a fresh sign-in
        for _ in range(6):
            try:
                await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=2500)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if (await self._safely(self._login, page) or await self._safely(self._cookies, page)
                    or await self._safely(self._error_page, page) or await self._safely(self._human_check, page)):
                page = self.page
                continue
            break
        await self._collect_closed(page)

    async def _safely(self, helper, page: Page) -> bool:
        """A helper that fails (a slow page, a detached element) just did nothing; the model sees the page as is."""
        try:
            return await helper(page)
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event(self.name, "helper_error", helper=helper.__name__, error=str(error).splitlines()[0][:160])
            return False

    async def _login(self, page: Page) -> bool:
        password = page.locator("input[type=password]:visible")
        if not await password.count() or self.logins >= 2:
            return False
        self.logins += 1
        form = password.first.locator("xpath=ancestor::form[1]")
        scope = form if await form.count() else page.locator("body")
        user = scope.locator("input:visible:not([type=password]):not([type=hidden]):not([type=checkbox])"
                             ":not([type=radio]):not([type=submit]):not([type=button])")
        if not await user.count():
            return False
        creds = self.site["credentials"]
        await user.first.fill(creds["username"])
        await password.first.fill(creds["password"])
        try:
            await password.first.press("Enter", timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            pass  # the form was sent; the page is still loading, which settle waits for
        self.events.append("signed in with this run's login")
        self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="login", url=page.url)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return True

    async def _cookies(self, page: Page) -> bool:
        buttons = page.locator("button:visible, input[type=submit]:visible")
        candidates = []
        for i in range(min(await buttons.count(), 20)):
            button = buttons.nth(i)
            text = (await button.inner_text() if await button.evaluate("e => e.tagName") == "BUTTON"
                    else await button.get_attribute("value")) or ""
            if COOKIE.search(text) and COOKIE_ANSWER.search(text):
                candidates.append((not COOKIE_MINIMAL.search(text), text.strip(), button))
        if not candidates:
            return False
        candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c[0])  # the necessary-only choice first
        _, text, button = candidates[0]
        await button.click()
        self.events.append(f"cookie notice answered with {text!r}")
        self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="cookies", choice=text)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        return True

    async def _human_check(self, page: Page) -> bool:
        done = []
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                done += await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate(HUMAN_CHECK_JS), FRAME_SECONDS)
            except Exception:
                continue
        if not done:
            return False
        self.events.append("unlocked a human check (" + ", ".join(sorted(set(done))) + ")")
        self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="human_check", done=done)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
        return True

    async def _error_page(self, page: Page) -> bool:
        try:
            body = await page.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=3000)
        except Exception:
            return False
        if len(body) > 1500 or not ERROR_PAGE.search(body):
            return False
        self.events.append("a transient error page showed; reloaded")
        self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="reload", url=page.url)
        await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
        try:
            await page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return True

    async def _collect_closed(self, page: Page) -> None:
        for frame in page.frames:
            try:
                closed = await asyncio.wait_for(frame.evaluate("(window.__arClosed || []).splice(0)"),
                                                FRAME_SECONDS)
            except Exception:
                continue
            for title in closed:
                self.events.append(f"closed popup {title!r} with its close button")
                self.trace.event(self.name, "helper", action="close_popup", title=title)

    async def look(self, offset: int = 0, brief: bool = False, fresh: bool = False) -> str:
        """What the model sees: the helpers' events, the tab, then the page text with refs.

        After an action on the same page, only the changed lines are sent when that is much shorter: the model still
        has its latest full view (worker.py keeps it), and unchanged lines keep their refs. Only with `brief` (the
        browser tools, whose result the model gets as is). `fresh` marks a whole view the model now holds (a
        worker's first prompt); other callers (helpers that reshape the text) get it whole and reset the baseline.
        """
        await self.revive()
        page = self.page
        await self._collect_closed(page)
        self.stamp += 1
        if offset == 0:
            try:
                self.view = await observe(page, str(self.stamp))
            except Exception as error:
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                try:
                    self.view = (await observe(page, str(self.stamp)) if not page.is_closed()
                                 else f"(page error {error})")
                except Exception as again:  # e.g. a script on the page hangs: the tab does not answer at all
                    self.view = f"(the page does not respond: {type(again).__name__} {str(again)[:160]})"
        try:
            title = await asyncio.wait_for(page.title(), FRAME_SECONDS)
        except Exception:
            title = ""
        header = [f"URL: {page.url}", f"Title: {title}"]
        notes = []
        if len(self.pages) > 1:
            notes.append(f"Windows open: {len(self.pages)} (you are in the newest)")
        if offset == 0 and page.url != self.last_url:
            self.last_url = page.url
            self.visits[page.url] = self.visits.get(page.url, 0) + 1
            if self.visits[page.url] >= LOOP_VISITS:  # a loop guard: paging back and forth finds nothing new
                notes.append(f"Note: you have arrived on this page {self.visits[page.url]} times; going back and "
                             f"forth between the same pages shows nothing new. Act on what this page offers (open "
                             f"an entry, its menu or its actions) or take another route.")
        if self.events:
            notes.append("Since your last action: " + "; ".join(self.events))
            self.events.clear()
        key = (page.url, title, self.view)
        if offset == 0 and brief and key == self.shown:
            return "\n".join([*notes, "The page is unchanged since your last action (same text and refs)."])
        if offset == 0:
            self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=self.view)
            self.seen += "\n" + self.view
            same_page = brief and self.base and self.base[:2] == key[:2] and len(self.view) <= MAX_VIEW
            diff = changes(self.base[2], self.view) if same_page else None
            if diff is not None:
                self.shown = key
                return "\n".join([*notes, "The page changed. Against your latest full view of it, only these parts "
                                   "differ now (- was there, + is new); everything else, refs included, is as there:",
                                   diff])
        text = self.view[offset:offset + MAX_VIEW]
        rest = len(self.view) - offset - len(text)
        if rest > 0:
            text += f"\n[... {rest} more characters: read_more(offset={offset + len(text)})]"
        self.shown = self.base = key if offset == 0 and rest <= 0 and (brief or fresh) else ()
        return "\n".join(header + notes) + "\n\n" + text

    async def act(self, kind: str, ref: str, fn) -> str:
        """Run one action on the element `ref`, settle, and return the new view."""
        async with self.lock:
            await self.revive()
            element = await locate(self.page, ref)
            if element is None:
                return (f"No element {ref} on this page (refs change with every view).\n\n"
                        + await self.look(brief=True))
            started = time.monotonic()
            before = (self.page.url, self.view)
            try:
                await fn(element)
            except Exception as error:
                first = str(error).splitlines()[0][:300]
                self.trace.event(self.name, "action_error", action=kind, ref=ref, error=first)
                return f"{kind} {ref} failed: {first}\n\n" + await self.look(brief=True)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            await self.settle()
            self.trace.event(self.name, "action", action=kind, ref=ref, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 2))
            view = await self.look(brief=True)
            if (self.page.url, self.view) == before:
                view = (f"Nothing on the page changed after {kind} {ref}. Do not repeat it; check the page for what "
                        f"is still missing (a required field, a checkbox, another button).\n\n") + view
            return view

        await element.click(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:

        await session._goto(target)

    submit=true presses Enter afterwards, which runs a search or sends the field's form.

    async def run(element):
        if await element.evaluate("e => e.type") == "range":
            await element.evaluate("(e, v) => { e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));"
                                   " e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }", text)
        else:

"""


def _option_index(choices: list[list[str]], option: str) -> int | None:
    """The option whose visible text (else value) is `option`, ignoring spacing and then case."""
    want = " ".join(option.split())
    for match in (lambda t, v: t == want, lambda t, v: v == option, lambda t, v: t.casefold() == want.casefold()):
        for i, (text, value) in enumerate(choices):
            if match(text, value):
                return i
    return None


def _close_options(texts: list[str], option: str, limit: int = 8) -> list[str]:
    """Options that contain `option`, else any of its words, for a helpful error."""
    want = option.casefold().strip()
    hits = [t for t in texts if want and want in t.casefold()]
    if not hits:
        words = [w for w in want.replace(",", " ").split() if len(w) > 1]
        hits = [t for t in texts if any(w in t.casefold() for w in words)]
    return hits[:limit]


async def select(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, option: str) -> str:
    """Choose an option of a select by its visible text."""
    async def run(element):
        choices = await element.evaluate(LABELS_JS)
        index = _option_index(choices, option)
        if index is None:
            texts = [text for text, _ in choices]
            close = _close_options(texts, option)
            hint = f"options like it: {' | '.join(close)}" if close else f"options({ref}, contains) searches them"
            raise ValueError(f"no option {option!r} among {len(texts)}; {hint}")
        await element.select_option(index=index, timeout=5000)
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("select", ref, run)


async def options(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, contains: str = "") -> str:
    """List the options of a select (views shorten long lists), or only those whose text contains `contains`."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    async with session.lock:
        found = await select_options(session.page, ref, contains)
    if found is None:
        return f"No select {ref} on this page (refs change with every view)."
    total, hits = found
    which = f" containing {contains!r}" if contains else ""
    text = f"{len(hits)} of {total} options of {ref}{which}:\n" + "\n".join(hits[:300])
    if len(hits) > 300:
        text += f"\n... {len(hits) - 300} more; narrow with contains"
    session.seen += "\n" + text
    return text


async def check(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, checked: bool = True) -> str:
    """Tick (checked=true) or untick a checkbox or radio button."""
    async def run(element):
        try:
            await element.set_checked(checked, timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("(e, c) => { if (e.checked !== c) e.click(); }", checked)
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("check", ref, run)


async def back(ctx: RunContext[Deps], reason: str = "") -> str:
    """Go back to the previous page."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    async with session.lock:
        try:
            await session.page.go_back(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        await session.settle()
        return await session.look(brief=True)


async def read_more(ctx: RunContext[Deps], offset: int) -> str:
    """Show the rest of a long page from the offset the view gave."""
    return await ctx.deps.session.look(offset)


# A run of value characters; those with a digit are values. (The former single pattern, [..]*\d[..]*, retried
# every start of a long run without a digit: quadratic, minutes on one long token.)
VALUE_RUN = re.compile(r"[\w/.:,+-]+")
DIGIT = re.compile(r"\d")


def unseen_values(text: str, seen: str) -> list[str]:
    """The values in `text` (anything with a digit: numbers, references, dates) that `seen` does not contain."""
    missing = []  # a value holds no whitespace, so searching `seen` as is matches its whitespace-normalised form
    for token in VALUE_RUN.findall(text):
        if not DIGIT.search(token):
            continue
        token = token.strip(".,:;/-+")
        if token and token not in seen and token not in missing:
            missing.append(token)
    return missing


async def note(ctx: RunContext[Deps], key: str, value: str) -> str:
    """Record a fact you can see on the current page (copy values exactly), so it survives if you run out of time."""
    missing = unseen_values(value, ctx.deps.session.seen)
    if missing:
        ctx.deps.session.trace.event(ctx.deps.session.name, "note_refused", key=key, missing=missing[:10])
        ctx.deps.refused[key] = ctx.deps.refused.get(key, 0) + 1
        if ctx.deps.refused[key] > 2:
            return (f"Not noted, again. Stop trying to note {key!r}; continue with your goal from what the current "
                    f"page shows.")
        return (f"Not noted: {', '.join(missing[:10])} appear on no page you have seen. Note only values copied "
                f"from a page; open the page again if you need to check.")
    ctx.deps.notes[key] = value
    ctx.deps.session.trace.event(ctx.deps.session.name, "note", key=key, value=value)
    return f"noted {key}"


TOOLS = [goto, click, fill, select, options, check, back, read_more, note]

"""
The agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

v2: read the brief, then the orchestrator (planner, findings board, research workers, verifier, calc) builds the
answer, and submit.py enters and signs the bid with it; without an answer every position is omitted, as in v1.
AGENT_RESEARCH=0 skips the research (the v1 path). See docs/plan.md.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import browsers
import loopwatch
import run as contract
from briefing import read_brief
from browser_tools import SiteSession
from orchestrator import Orchestrator
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from submit import Mailbox, submit_bid
from tracing import Trace

SAFETY_SECONDS = 90  # the answer must be in before the run expires
LOCAL_SECONDS = 20 * 60  # the scouting run does not expire; behave like a scored run


async def solve(task: dict, page, answer: dict | None = None,
                attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """
    Enter the bid on the run's website (a "site" submission) and return None.

    `answer` (calc's BidResult.answer()) and `attributes` (per position, the chosen material's attributes) are what
    the bid worker enters; positions they do not give completely are omitted. Unless given, the orchestrator
    researches them; a research failure never costs the signed bid.
    """
    trace = Trace()
    loopwatch.Watchdog(activity=lambda: trace.last).start()  # a blocked loop or a silent run dumps its stacks
    left = min(contract.seconds_left(task), LOCAL_SECONDS)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + left - SAFETY_SECONDS
    # Sign in to every website while the model reads the brief: which one plays which part is only known after it.
    contexts = await browsers.more_contexts(page, len(task["access"]))
    sessions = {site["siteId"]: SiteSession(site, context, trace) for site, context in zip(task["access"], contexts)}
    started = asyncio.gather(*(session.start() for session in sessions.values()), return_exceptions=True)
    briefing, outcomes = await asyncio.gather(read_brief(task), started)
    # The run contract names the submission website; it wins over the model's reading of the brief.
    contract_site = (task.get("submission") or {}).get("siteId")
    if contract_site in sessions and contract_site != briefing.bid_site:
        trace.event("briefing", "bid_site_corrected", read=briefing.bid_site, contract=contract_site)
        briefing = briefing.model_copy(update={"bid_site": contract_site})
    trace.event("briefing", "done", **briefing.model_dump(exclude={"submission_steps"}))
    failed = {name for name, outcome in zip(sessions, outcomes) if isinstance(outcome, BaseException)}
    bid, mail = sessions[briefing.bid_site], sessions[briefing.mail_site]
    await asyncio.gather(*(session.start() for session in (bid, mail) if session.name in failed),
                         return_exceptions=True)  # submit_bid copes with a session that is still down
    if answer is None and os.environ.get("AGENT_RESEARCH", "1") != "0":
        answer, attributes = await research(task, briefing, contexts, trace, deadline)
    try:
        result = await submit_bid(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline, answer, attributes)
    except Exception as error:  # never end without trying to sign: one more pass with what is on screen
        trace.event("submit", "crashed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
        result = await submit_bid(bid, Mailbox(mail, briefing, deadline), briefing, deadline, answer, attributes)
    trace.event("result", "done", result=result.model_dump() if result else None)
    return None


async def research(task: dict, briefing, contexts: list, trace: Trace, deadline: float
                   ) -> tuple[dict | None, dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None]:
    """The orchestrator's answer and material attributes; (None, None) when it fails or builds nothing."""
    answer, attributes, problems = None, None, []
    orchestrator = None
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        orchestrator = Orchestrator(task, briefing, {s["siteId"]: c for s, c in zip(task["access"], contexts)},
                                    trace, deadline)
        problems = orchestrator.board.problems
        answer, _ = await orchestrator.run()
        attributes = orchestrator.attributes
    except Exception as error:  # the signed bid must never be lost to a research failure
        trace.event("orchestrator", "failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
    if answer is None and orchestrator is not None:  # still the reference, decision and any discount read
        answer = orchestrator.fallback_answer()
    trace.event("orchestrator", "done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), answer=answer,
                attributes=attributes, problems=problems[:30])
    path = Path(trace.path).with_name("answer.json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    print(f"Answer for the bid form written to {path}", flush=True)
    return answer, attributes


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright)  # more browsers: browsers.connect(playwright, 1), ...
        answer = await solve(task, page)
    if answer is None:
        print("No answer to submit through the API: the bid is entered on the website", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, task: dict, briefing: Briefing, contexts: dict[str, BrowserContext], trace: Trace,
                 deadline: float):
        self.task, self.briefing, self.contexts, self.trace = task, briefing, contexts, trace
        self.access = {s["siteId"]: s for s in task["access"]}
        self.deadline = deadline
        self.research_deadline = deadline - SUBMIT_SECONDS
        self.board = Board(trace)
        self.reference = briefing.tender_reference
        self.scenario = scenario_time(briefing.scenario_date)
        self.scenario_day: date = self.scenario.date()
        # calc compares two timestamps as instants and anything date-only by day: hand it the brief's own grain.
        self.scenario_stamp: date | datetime = (self.scenario if re.search(r"\d:\d\d", briefing.scenario_date)
                                                else self.scenario_day)
        self.rules = rules_text(task["brief"])
        self.plan: Plan | None = None
        self.tender_facts = None
        self.mail_facts = None
        self.spec: SpecResult | None = None
        self.erp: ErpResearch | None = None
        self._erp: Erp | None = None
        self.requirements: dict[str, Requirement] = {}
        self.spec_revision: str | None = None  # the revision the requirements so far come from
        self.chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
        self.mail_kinds: list = []
        self.mail_sessions: list[SiteSession] = []
        self.rework: dict[str, object] = {}  # worker -> coroutine function for doubtful facts
        self.blank_hints: dict[str, set[str]] = {}  # position -> answer fields that stay blank
        self.attributes: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}  # position -> chosen material's attributes, for the form
        self.mailbox = ""
        self.mail_results: dict[str, object] = {}  # record kind -> research_mail.KindResult
        # The mail side is the slowest (a planner and about nine record kinds): it gets its own deadline, and
        # calc runs with whatever records exist by then.
        self.mail_deadline = min(self.research_deadline, time.monotonic() + MAIL_SECONDS)

    def left(self) -> float:
        return self.research_deadline - time.monotonic()

    def form_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds until the bid form must start."""
        return self.deadline - FORM_SECONDS - time.monotonic()

    async def _bounded(self, step, name: str) -> None:
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(step, max(1.0, self.form_left()))
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem(name, f"stopped: {type(error).__name__} (the bid form needs the time)")

    async def session(self, site: str, tag: str = "") -> SiteSession:
        access = self.access[site]
        if tag:
            access = {**access, "siteId": f"{site}:{tag}"}
        return await start_session(SiteSession(access, self.contexts[site], self.trace))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ workers

    async def tender(self, site: str) -> None:
        board = self.board
        try:
            session, qa_session = await asyncio.gather(self.session(site, "tender"), self.session(site, "qa"),
                                                       return_exceptions=True)
            if isinstance(session, BaseException):
                if isinstance(qa_session, BaseException):
                    raise session
                session, qa_session = qa_session, None
            elif isinstance(qa_session, BaseException):
                board.problem("tender", f"no second tab ({type(qa_session).__name__}); one worker reads all")
                qa_session = None
            for key, value in (getattr(facts, table, None) or {}).items():
                post(kind, key, [v.model_dump(mode="json") for v in value] if isinstance(value, list) else value)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the pipeline

    async def research(self) -> None:
        self.plan = await plan_research(self.task, self.briefing)
        self.trace.event("plan", "done", needs=[f"{n.kind}@{n.site}: {n.why}" for n in self.plan.needs])
        sites: dict[str, list[str]] = {}  # a role may be spread over several websites in another dataset
        for n in self.plan.needs:
            if n.site not in sites.setdefault(n.kind, []):
                sites[n.kind].append(n.site)
        jobs = []
        if "tender" in sites and research_tender is not None:
            jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self.tender(site), name=f"tender@{site}") for site in sites["tender"]]
        elif "tender" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "tender research module not available")
        erp_sites = sites.get("materials", [])
        if len(erp_sites) > 1:
            self.board.problem("plan", f"materials on several sites {erp_sites}; only the first is searched")
        for site in sites.get("specification", []):
            jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self.specification(site, erp_sites[0] if erp_sites else None),
                                            name=f"specification@{site}"))
        if "mails" in sites and research_mail is not None:
            jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self.mails(site), name=f"mails@{site}") for site in sites["mails"]]
        elif "mails" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "mail research module not available")
        if not jobs:
            return
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:  # the deadline guard: whatever is complete goes on
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if self._erp is not None:  # ERP workers still browsing would compete with the bid form for the browser
            for task in [*self._erp.tasks.values(), *self._erp.materials.values()]:
                if not task.done():
                    task.cancel()
            if self.erp is None:  # stopped at the deadline: what finished still counts
                so_far = getattr(self._erp, "so_far", None)
                self.erp = so_far() if so_far is not None else self._finished_erp()
        self.rework = {"mails": self._rework_mail}

    def _finished_erp(self) -> ErpResearch:
        def finished(tasks):
                                approval=approval if isinstance(approval, calc.Approval) else None)
            return calc.calculate(bid).answer()
        except Exception:
            return {"tender_reference": self.reference, "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR",
                    "discount_percent": 0.0, "positions": [], "total_net": 0.0}

    async def run(self) -> tuple[dict | None, calc.BidResult | None]:
        """Research, verify, calculate: the answer dict for the bid form. Positions that are not complete are
        omitted; with none complete it is still a bid with reference, decision and discount."""
        await self.research()
        # The deadline guard after research: each step runs only in the time the bid form leaves it.
        if self.form_left() > 60:
            await self._bounded(self.verify(), "verify")
        await self._bounded(self.select_materials(), "select")
        bid, problems = self.build_bid()
        self.trace.event("calc", "input", positions=[p.position for p in bid.positions], problems=problems)
        if not bid.positions:
            self.board.problem("calc", "no position could be built; the bid goes in with every position omitted")
        result, blank, calc_problems = safe_calculate(bid)
        for position, fields in self.blank_hints.items():
            blank.setdefault(position, set()).update(fields)
        problems += calc_problems
        if result is None:  # still a bid: reference, decision and discount score without positions
            answer = self.fallback_answer()
            self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, fallback=True)
            return answer, None
        check = None if self.form_left() < 30 else await confirm_decision(result.decision, self.board.summary() + "\n\nProblems:\n"
                                       + "\n".join(self.board.problems + problems), self.rules)
        if check is not None and not check.agrees:
            self.trace.event("verify", "decision_disputed", proposed=result.decision, wanted=check.decision,
                             reason=check.reason)
        if check is not None and check.decision == "no_bid" and result.decision == "bid" and result.missing_materials:
            result = result.model_copy(update={"decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": Decimal("0.00")})
        answer = answer_from(result, blank)
        self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, blank={k: sorted(v) for k, v in blank.items()})
        return answer, result

        self.trace.event("calc", "input", positions=[p.position for p in bid.positions], problems=problems)
        if not bid.positions:
            self.board.problem("calc", "no position could be built; the bid goes in with every position omitted")
        result, blank, calc_problems = safe_calculate(bid)
        for position, fields in self.blank_hints.items():
            blank.setdefault(position, set()).update(fields)
        problems += calc_problems
        if result is None:  # still a bid: reference, decision and discount score without positions
            answer = self.fallback_answer()
            self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, fallback=True)
            return answer, None
        check = None if self.form_left() < 30 else await confirm_decision(result.decision, self.board.summary() + "\n\nProblems:\n"
                                       + "\n".join(self.board.problems + problems), self.rules)
        if check is not None and not check.agrees:
            self.trace.event("verify", "decision_disputed", proposed=result.decision, wanted=check.decision,
                             reason=check.reason)
        if check is not None and check.decision == "no_bid" and result.decision == "bid" and result.missing_materials:
            result = result.model_copy(update={"decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": Decimal("0.00")})
        answer = answer_from(result, blank)
        self.trace.event("calc", "answer", answer=answer, problems=problems, blank={k: sorted(v) for k, v in blank.items()})
        return answer, result

"""The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.

In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
`uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
"""
import json
import os


def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
    """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
    try:
        urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
    except ValueError:
        urls = []
    return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])


async def _launch_local(playwright):
    """A Chromium of the kit's own, for runs on your machine only: in a run the sandbox stops browsers the agent
    starts, so a missing CDP_URLS there is an error, not a reason to launch one."""
    if os.environ.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"):
        raise RuntimeError("In a run the sandbox provides the browsers (CDP_URLS); refusing to launch one")
    return await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")


async def connect(playwright, number: int = 0):
    """Browser `number` of the run (0 is browser 1) and a page in it. Locally, a Chromium of its own."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    if urls:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
        context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
    else:
        browser = await _launch_local(playwright)
        context = await browser.new_context()
    page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
    return browser, page


async def contexts(playwright, count: int) -> list:
    """`count` browser contexts to work websites in, spread over the run's browsers (round robin). Locally they are
    separate contexts of one Chromium of its own, at the sandbox's 1280×800."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    if urls:
        browsers = [await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(url) for url in urls[:count]]
        found = []
        for i in range(count):
            browser = browsers[i % len(browsers)]
            found.append(browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context())
        return found
    browser = await _launch_local(playwright)
    return [await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800}) for _ in range(count)]


async def more_contexts(page, count: int) -> list:
    """Browser contexts for `count` websites, the first being `page`'s. In a run, website n gets browser n where the
    run has one (agent.json "browsers"), else a further context of browser 1; locally, contexts of the kit's own
    Chromium at the sandbox's 1280×800."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    found = [page.context]
    for number in range(1, count):
        if number < len(urls):
            browser = await page.context.browser.browser_type.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
            found.append(browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context())
        else:
            found.append(await page.context.browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800}))
    return found

self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        """The bidder's own address, or "" when the webmail cannot tell: never an error that would stop the bid."""
        try:
            async with self.lock:
                found, _ = await run_worker(
                    self.session, "Find the email address of the mailbox you are signed in to (the bidder's own "
                    "address, usually shown as the signed-in account). Return it at once.",
                    MailboxAddress, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=8, notes=False)
        except Exception as error:
            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"address: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            return ""
        return found.address if found else ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = "") -> SigningTan | None:
        """
        The signing TAN just requested. The sites run on the scenario's clock, so "newest" is the highest request
        number or the top of the list, never a wall-clock time. `answer` is what the bid website said to the request
        (it may name the request), so the mail worker can pick that very message.
        """
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        try:
            return await self._tan(older, said, answer)
        except Exception as error:  # the bid worker asks again; an error here must not stop the bid
            self.session.trace.event(self.session.name, "stopped", reason=f"tan: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            return None

    async def _tan(self, older: str, said: str, answer: str) -> SigningTan | None:
        async with self.lock:
            async with self.session.lock:  # the list the tab shows predates the request: load it again
                await self.session.revive()
                await self.session._goto(self.session.page.url)
            found, _ = await run_worker(
                self.session, f"A new signing TAN for tender {self.briefing.tender_reference} was just requested."
                f"{said} Open the newest signing TAN message for exactly this tender reference (the highest "
                "request number; new TAN messages are listed without a search, newest first; reload the list once "
                "if it is not there yet), copy the TAN from its text and return it at once. If a preview pane "
                f"stays empty, open the message's own page through its link.{older}",
                SigningTan, context=answer, deadline=self.deadline, max_steps=10, notes=False)
        if found:
            self.last_tan = found.tan
        return found


class FormAction(BaseModel):
    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")


async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
    if step.action == "fill":
        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action == "select":
        if not step.value:
            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
    else:
        try:
            await element.click(timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
    """
    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    done: list[str] = []
    stop = ""
    async with session.lock:
        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
        for step in actions:
            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
            if element is None:
                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
                break
            try:
                await _perform(element, step)
            except Exception as error:
                stop = f"{step.action} {step.ref} {step.value!r} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
                break
            done.append(f"{step.action} {step.ref}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
            if page.is_closed() or page.url != url or len(session.pages) != windows:
                if step is not actions[-1]:
                    stop = "the page changed after it; the remaining actions were not done"
                break

class FormAction(BaseModel):
    ref: str = Field(description="The element's ref in the latest view")
    action: Literal["fill", "select", "check", "uncheck", "click"]
    value: str = Field("", description="fill: the text to type; select: the option's visible text, exactly as the "
                                       "view lists it; empty for check, uncheck and click")


async def _perform(element, step: FormAction) -> None:
    if step.action == "fill":
        await element.fill(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action == "select":
        if not step.value:
            raise ValueError("select needs the option's visible text as value")
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=step.value, timeout=2000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(step.value, timeout=2000)
    elif step.action in ("check", "uncheck"):
        await element.set_checked(step.action == "check", timeout=2000)
    else:
        try:
            await element.click(timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")


async def fill_in(ctx: RunContext[Deps], actions: list[FormAction]) -> str:
    """
    Do several actions on the current page in one go, in this order: fill textboxes, choose options, tick boxes,
    or click buttons that keep you on this page (such as one per table row). Use refs from the latest view. It
    stops at the first action that fails or that leaves the page, and returns the new view. Put a button that
    moves to the next step only last, or click it on its own.
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    done: list[str] = []
    stop = ""
    async with session.lock:
        page, url, windows = session.page, session.page.url, len(session.pages)
        for step in actions:
            element = await locate(page, step.ref)
            if element is None:
                stop = f"no element {step.ref} (the page changed; use the new view)"
                break
            try:
                await _perform(element, step)
            except Exception as error:
                stop = f"{step.action} {step.ref} {step.value!r} failed: {str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]}"
                break
            done.append(f"{step.action} {step.ref}")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
            if page.is_closed() or page.url != url or len(session.pages) != windows:
                if step is not actions[-1]:
                    stop = "the page changed after it; the remaining actions were not done"
                break
